title: Expose rope capsule pairs and attachments
scope: Add the rope-capsule profile, rope-rope edge and typed endpoint attachment parameters; advertise nothing.
acceptance: Registry, generated API and specification separate node-only self contact, capsule self/pair contact and attachment.
Validation rejects invalid selectors, parameters, duplicate/reversed edges and unsupported bundles atomically.
evidence: PASS: cmake --build build-windows-d3d12-preview --target parallel-mater-driver-slang-d3d12 --config Release --parallel 4; MSVC 19.44 on Windows GTX 1080.
PASS: parallel-mater-graph-validation-tests.exe with the slang-d3d12 manifest; invalid selectors and parameters, duplicate or reversed edges, and unsupported bundles preserve the active graph.
PASS: parallel-mater-interaction-capability-tests.exe with the slang-d3d12 manifest; rope-capsule contact and attachment remain unadvertised.
PASS: tools/reference/bootstrap.py --build and tools/reference/check.py --skip-vulkan-header; generated headers, specification, coverage, PDFs, ABI syntax and deterministic regeneration passed.
PASS: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/roadmap -p test_*.py; 72 roadmap and lease tests passed.
